## Weekly Update - 2026-10-18

Hey <@&1424461167883194418> — a lot grew this week. Here’s the useful part:

🪴 **Sandboxes that stick around**
Sandbox timeouts can extend beyond a day. Daily restarts preserve files, memory and processes, though open connections drop. Enter now brings creation, SSH instructions and lifecycle controls onto one page; Machines MCP adds sandbox controls for agents.

🎬 **Models and media**
Kandinsky adds short-video generation; Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo adds image generation and editing. The catalog also gained chat models, two Lightning Text versions and typed-decision models. Mirelo can add synchronized sound effects to a source video, and OpenAI speech gained adjustable speed.

⏳ **Jobs that outlast a request**
Image, video, audio and 3D requests gained `Prefer: respond-async`, with job status and results available through the API or SDK. The SDK also added 3D generation, word-timed speech, model-status queries, React generation hooks and an AI SDK chat transport. One HTTP connection no longer has to supervise the whole project.

🔑 **Agents and access**
Agent Skills and discovery docs make the API easier for agents to find. Computer MCP gained JavaScript execution. Keys can be scoped to individual model IDs, with narrower permission grants; interactive API docs and plain HTML apps gained simpler account connection via `<polli-connect>`.

🌱 **Around the edges**
Quests gained event-code and one-time Discord level rewards. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash gained Quest Pollen access. Keyboard and screen-reader controls improved, and uploads gained an opt-in setting to strip supported image metadata.

Code and changes: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations
